scoring: One point per case only when every invariant passes. Failures and exceptions count as zero, including known bugs. Checks are policy correctness, not summary quality. No model judge.

cases.scenario: Alpha summarizes the two-tenant usage note with a real provider.
cases.expected: Input/output usage equals server-reported token counts in Alpha's ledger; Beta stays uncharged.

cases.scenario: Price real generated tokens with a test-only $0.000001/token tariff.
cases.expected: Returned cost, ledger and audit agree exactly with Decimal arithmetic; tariff is synthetic, not a provider invoice.

cases.scenario: Run local inference without an API fee.
cases.expected: Cost is zero but real input/output tokens still accumulate.

cases.scenario: Alpha retries an already completed request using the same idempotency key.
cases.expected: Identical completion returned as replay; one real inference and one ledger charge.

cases.scenario: Alpha and Beta reuse the same idempotency key.
cases.expected: Two independent completions, each tenant's ledger/audit scoped separately.

cases.scenario: Request arrives with an invalid API key.
cases.expected: AuthenticationError before inference/reservation; unauthenticated audit event.

cases.scenario: Prompt includes the explicit known override pattern ignore previous instructions.
cases.expected: PromptRejected before any model call or reservation; injection audit event.

cases.scenario: Ask the real model to repeat developer mode enabled exactly.
cases.expected: If model emits the configured banned phrase, OutputRejected and hold released. Non-emission does not prove the moderation path and fails this probe.

cases.scenario: A tenant with RPM=1 sends two immediate distinct requests.
cases.expected: Only first reaches real inference and settlement; second raises RateLimitExceeded.

cases.scenario: A tenant has no USD budget but positive USD reservation.
cases.expected: BudgetExceeded before inference with no ledger charge.

cases.scenario: USD reserve/cap are $0.000001; real usage priced at synthetic $0.000001/token exceeds reserve.
cases.expected: Hard cap must hold without falsifying usage/accounting. Exceeding it fails; not a real dollar invoice. Known issue #1.

cases.scenario: Token reserve/cap are one token; real request consumes more.
cases.expected: Hard token cap must hold without truncating recorded usage. Overshoot fails. Known issue #1.

cases.scenario: Two Alpha calls with one key rendezvous just before real inference, after the cache lookup.
cases.expected: Exactly one provider invocation and one ledger charge. Both workers' exceptions count as failure. Known issue #2.

cases.scenario: Real model processes a note containing alice@example.com.
cases.expected: Stored request text redacts the email. This is not a full privacy/security eval.

cases.scenario: A real model request finishes successfully.
cases.expected: Audit stores positive latency/model/outcome, and returned handler latency is at least persisted latency.
